system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Input to the sub-agent comprises of the code repository, information obtained from other sub-agents as necessary, a set of allowed actions and task instructions.
system_prompt_style.note: Repo contains only README; per-sub-agent prompts filled with upstream outputs inferred from paper prose.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The Edit Localizer navigates the repository to find files related to the buggy behaviour of GaussianMixture
env_context_strategy.note: READ/LIST/COMMAND actions; READ returns lazy signature summaries.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: COMMAND(command): Executes the command in a shell with timeout and truncation of large results.
context_compaction.note: READ also returns lazy signature-only views of files and classes.

observation_format.evidence_quote: When reading a file, only signatures of the top level definitions are presented

tool_call_format.note: Action names given (READ, EDIT...) but call syntax not described.

tool_count.evidence_quote: The actions we use in this work are:
tool_count.note: READ, EDIT, ADD, WRITE, LIST, COMMAND, DONE; subsets per sub-agent.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: For each edit, the Fixer expects the LLM to output the original version of the code snippet (pre) followed by the edited version of this snippet (post).
edit_primitive.note: Line-numbered pre/post with fuzzy matching; WRITE(file, contents) for tests. Line numbers used for locating, closest value search_replace.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The sub-agents are composed by passing the output from one sub-agent to the input of another sub-agent.
loop_primitives.note: ReAct sub-agents; Fixer samples 5 patches, Ranker selects using generated test; Test Template Generator retries until test passes.

planning_granularity.note: Fixed decomposition into sub-agents; no stored plan object described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the sub-agents are given modular objectives that do not require explicit one-to-one or group conversations between sub-agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: We instantiate 5 sub-agents to collectively resolve repository-level issues.
delegation_mechanism.note: Fixed pipeline hand-off of outputs; closest value subagent_spawn (role_handoff also plausible).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Output: List of code locations (specified through the EDIT and ADD commands) to edit.
short_term_state.note: Marked edit locations and typed sub-agent outputs passed between stages.

self_verification.evidence_quote: For each of the patches, Ranker first runs the test on each of the patches and then asks the LLM to determine whether the application of that patch to the repository has caused the provided test to change status
self_verification.note: Also: Syntactically incorrect edits are rejected (Sec. 2.3).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: limit Test Template Generator to 3 retries
retry_policy.note: Retry scoped to Test Template Generator sub-agent; Fixer samples 5 candidates (multi-attempt).

termination_condition.evidence_quote: DONE: Used by the agent to signal that it has completed its assigned objective.

cost_controls.note: Average cost 1.96 USD reported, no budget mechanism described.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Executes the command in a shell with timeout and truncation of large results.

execution_isolation.note: Paper says a fresh development environment is set up; boundary not specified.

eval_hooks.note: Evaluated with external SWE-bench Lite harness; repo has only README.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Syntactically incorrect edits are rejected and the resultant patches are used downstream.
guardrails.note: Also discards edits to pre-existing tests (Sec. 3).

target_domain.evidence_quote: Modular Architecture for Software-engineering AI (MASAI) agents

open_source.note: Repo contains only README; no source code or licence published.

model_agnostic.note: Only GPT-4o used; paper says modularity permits different LMs.

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date; no tags evidenced.

stars.note: Date of star count not stated.
